verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's core product is a documented public inference API. It is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai, set up by changing the base URL, API key and model, with documented request parameters such as service_tier, fail_fast and reasoning_effort. An AI-native user can drive it programmatically with existing OpenAI SDKs. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404 at every candidate path, and llms.txt is also 404), documented API coverage beyond inference (e.g. managing deployments or clusters), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Point your existing OpenAI SDK to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` and your code works without changes. No migration required.
OpenAI-compatible chat completions API — just change the base URL and model name.
Set service_tier to "priority" to request priority inference on supported models.
Set the optional fail_fast parameter to true to get an immediate HTTP 429 instead of waiting.
